description.en: Put the agent's behavior into cards: prompts, resources and tools are decoupled from the session and loaded per task. Three layers: task-oriented (prompt and resources off the session), rich tooling (long-running multi-project work), identity cards (per-session persona and rules). Ships middleware cleanup, a local file index, and on-demand tool loading.
description.zh: 把「AI 该按什么方式干活」做成一套卡：提示词、资源、工具都与会话解耦，按任务加载。三层解耦：面向任务（提示词和资源离开会话）、丰富工具（支持长期多项目开发）、身份卡（会话与资源、提示词解耦的进一步，支持个性化自定义）。附带中间件清理、本地资料索引与工具按需加载。
